title: Shroud body-image albedo LUT (JJE 1984 model under seven illuminants)
method: CIE 1931 2 degree observer, 380-780 nm in 5 nm steps; reflectance held at its 300 and 700 nm values outside the fitted range; illuminant white adapted to D65 (CAT02); linear sRGB (Rec. 709 primaries); clipped to [0, 1]. Identical to unity/v3-collateral/bake_shroud_spectral_lut.py.
encoding: linear; import as data (no sRGB decoding)

illuminants.name: oil_lamp_2000K
illuminants.label: oil lamp, as a 2000 K blackbody

illuminants.name: strobe_5500K
illuminants.label: STURP 1978 flash, approximated by a 5500 K blackbody

illuminants.name: led_museum_4000K
illuminants.label: museum LED, approximated by a 4000 K blackbody

albedo_rule: albedo = lerp(LUT row at h=0, LUT row at h=1, h)
